signals_info.description: Normalized risk for the selected pedestrian or cyclist.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 1 and 3 seconds from now, the vulnerable-road-user risk shall be less than or equal to 0.7.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 3 秒之间，弱势道路使用者风险应至少有一个时刻小于或等于 0.7。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the window from the first through the third second, the assessed pedestrian-or-cyclist risk shall be no greater than 0.7 at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 1 秒至第 3 秒的窗口内，行人或骑行者风险评估值应至少有一个时刻不高于 0.7。
